title: What Happens to Options as the Clock Runs Down?
summary: What happens to an option's value as expiration approaches? Interactive Brokers' Jeff Praissman welcomes Mat Cashman from the Options Industry Council (OIC) to explore how time influences options pricing, why identical stock movements can produce different outcomes, and how delta, gamma, theta, and vega factor into choosing the right expiration date.
